exposure: mode of misoprostol administration (oral vs. vaginal insert)
outcome: perception of length of hospital stay
cohort: 123 nulliparous women undergoing medical induction of labour
finding: Women induced with oral misoprostol reported a better experience of labour than those induced with a slow-release misoprostol vaginal insert.
mod_finding: Women induced with oral misoprostol reported a better experience of labour than those induced with a slow-release misoprostol vaginal insert.
